scripts.setup: bash scripts/setup-piper.sh && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n server,web,chatterbox -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web" "npm run chatterbox"
